Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Half of commanding is knowing which half of the room is supposed to move.

Choose up to four allies who can hear and understand you and split them into two groups. Until the start of your next turn, one group gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and cannot be moved against their will by any effect of your level or lower; the other group gains a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds. You choose which group is which when you give the order.
